name: speccy
description: An elegant OpenAPI reference renderer for the web, macOS, and Docusaurus.

scripts.build: npm run build -w speccy-renderer && npm run build -w speccy-docusaurus && npm run build -w @speccy/web && npm run build -w @speccy/docusaurus-demo && npm run build -w create-speccy-reference
scripts.test: npm run test -w speccy-renderer && npm run test -w speccy-docusaurus && npm run test -w @speccy/web && npm run test -w create-speccy-reference
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w speccy-renderer && npm run typecheck -w speccy-docusaurus && npm run typecheck -w @speccy/web && npm run typecheck -w @speccy/docusaurus-demo && npm run typecheck -w create-speccy-reference
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
